front.title: Reading Ethernet Multicast Addresses in IPv4 and IPv6 Packet Traces

abstract.t: A packet trace may show the same Ethernet destination address for two packets sent to different IP multicast groups. This note gives worked IPv4 and IPv6 examples for readers interpreting such traces. For each address family, one pair of inputs differs in a bit that the Ethernet mapping discards. A third input differs in a bit that the mapping retains. The examples exercise existing mapping rules.
